info.title: ClaimSense governed door (AutoSure, synthetic) — Gateway subset
info.description: The REST face of the ClaimSense door, trimmed to the operations an AgentCore Gateway target would expose as MCP tools. Each operationId becomes an MCP tool name. Grants (deny-by-default), entitlement and the audit trail are enforced INSIDE the door on every call; the Gateway replaces tool wiring and key handling, never enforcement.

bearer.description: The adjuster's Cognito ID token, or a door-issued delegated (OBO) token. Never a shared key: per-user scope depends on it.

get.summary: Claims Management: one claim's facts (scope-checked; missing and forbidden look the same).

200.description: the claim, or a not_found_or_forbidden error (denial audited)

get.summary: Document Store: the documents on file for a claim.
Document Store: one document (content is untrusted third-party text).
Policy & Coverage KB: clauses with provenance (G2 quarantines the rest).
